description: Source code for the 'Inspector' class in the Android bugreport analysis tool. It processes bugreport data, logcat logs, and stack traces to identify processes, threads, deadlocks, and interesting log lines, and annotates the data for further analysis or display.

classes.name: Inspector
classes.description: Main class for analyzing and annotating parsed bugreport data, including processes, threads, logcat logs, and deadlocks.

classes.name: InterestingLineMatcher
classes.description: Helper class to identify interesting log lines based on tag and regex pattern.

methods.name: inspect
methods.description: Performs the full analysis and annotation of the bugreport data.

methods.name: makeProcessInfo
methods.description: Extracts process and thread info from VM traces and adds to the bugreport.

methods.name: findAnr
methods.description: Detects an ANR in the logcat if not already set.

methods.name: inspectProcesses
methods.description: Performs process and thread analysis on a list of processes.

methods.name: combineLocks
methods.description: Aggregates lock information from stack frames and tags threads accordingly.

methods.name: markBinderThreads
methods.description: Identifies threads involved in binder transactions.

methods.name: markOutgoingBinderThread
methods.description: Detects if a thread is doing an outgoing binder transaction.

methods.name: markIncomingBinderThread
methods.description: Detects if a thread is handling an incoming binder transaction.

methods.name: fixBinderClass
methods.description: Cleans up binder class names by removing suffixes or inlining conventions.

methods.name: markBlockedThreads
methods.description: Flags threads that are blocked on locks.

methods.name: isThreadBlocked
methods.description: Checks if a thread is blocked on at least one lock.

methods.name: markInterestingThreads
methods.description: Flags threads that are considered interesting for analysis.

methods.name: matchesJavaStack
methods.description: Checks if a thread's Java stack matches a given signature.

methods.name: markDeadlocks
methods.description: Detects deadlocks among threads.

methods.name: inventLogcatTimes
methods.description: Fills in missing timestamps in log lines.

methods.name: mergeLogcat
methods.description: Merges system and event logs into a single logcat stream.

methods.name: makeInterestingLogcat
methods.description: Identifies and marks interesting log lines for display.

methods.name: markLogcatProcessesAndThreads
methods.description: Associates log lines with processes and threads.

methods.name: markAnrLogcatRegions
methods.description: Marks log lines during ANR periods based on log patterns.

methods.name: markAnrRegion
methods.description: Marks log lines within a specific time range as part of an ANR.

methods.name: markBugreportRegions
methods.description: Marks log lines captured during the bugreport period.

methods.name: trimLogcat
methods.description: Limits logcat display to recent relevant lines.
